[SWS_CORE_01396] swap overload for Vector
⌈
There shall be an over-
load of the swap function within the namespace ara::core for arguments of type
Vector. Its interface shall be equivalent to:
template <typename T, typename Allocator>
void swap(Vector<T, Allocator>& lhs, Vector<T, Allocator>& rhs);
This function shall exchange the state of lhs with that of rhs.
⌋
